ctx.s:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.23.x"
          cache: true
      - name: Check formatting
        run: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"
      - name: Vet
        run: go vet ./...
      - name: Test with race detector
        run: go test -race -count=1 ./...
      - name: Cross-compile static Linux binaries
        run: make cross
      - name: Smoke-test Linux binary
        run: ./dist/vigil-linux-amd64 version

ctx.s:
name: Release
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*.*.*"]
permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.23.x"
      - name: Test
        run: go test -race -count=1 ./...
      - name: Build release assets
        run: make release VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" COMMIT="${GITHUB_SHA}" DATE="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
      - name: Install cosign
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3
      - name: Keylessly sign checksums
        env:
          COSIGN_YES: "true"
        run: |
          cosign sign-blob --output-signature dist/SHA256SUMS.sig --output-certificate dist/SHA256SUMS.pem dist/SHA256SUMS
      - name: Publish GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh release create "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" dist/* --generate-notes --verify-tag

# Contributing to Vigil

Thank you for improving validator operations. Vigil optimizes for correctness, low noise, auditability, and a small trusted computing baseânot feature count.

## Non-negotiable boundaries

Pull requests must not add private-key access, signing, transaction submission, automatic identity switching, automatic failover, or host/val

r mutation. Advisory output and read-only evidence collection are welcome.

## Development setup

Use Go 1.23 or newer on Linux for the most representative environment.

```bash
make fmt-check
make vet
make test
make race
make cross
```

The project currently has no third-party Go dependencies. Adding one requires a clear justification

nd an explanation of why the standard library is insufficient.

## High-risk changes

Add focused tests and documentation for any change to:

- VAT rent adjustment, runway arithmetic, or next-epoch sufficiency.
-

tion, recovery, persistence, or secret handling.
- Metric names, label cardinality, or exporter concur

ry inputs. A failed observation must not silently become a zero or healthy value.

## Protocol and client changes

Cite primary protocol/client documentation in the pull request. Keep fee values and operator thresholds configurable. Distingu

g unless it actually reads and validates certificate evidence.

## Pull request checklist

- [ ] Scope is limited and read-only.
- [ ] `make fmt-check vet test race cross` passes on Linux.
- [ ] New behavior has tests

ure paths.
- [ ] Metrics do not add per-slot or other unbounded labels.
- [ ] Secrets are not logged, embedded in config examples, or included in tes

ible config or metric changes are called out in the changelog.

## Bug reports

Include `vigil version`, OS/kernel, validator client/version, relevant public configuration with secrets removed, and the smallest reproduction possible. Never attach private keys, seed phrase

package main

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/ValidatorStack/solana-vigil/internal/agent"
	"github.com/ValidatorStack/solana-vigil/internal/cli"
)

func main() {
	agent.Ensure()

	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	os.Exit(cli.Run(ctx, os.Args[1:], os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr))
}

[Unit]
Description=Vigil read-only Solana validator watcher
Documentation=https://github.com/ValidatorStack/solana-vigil
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=vigil
Group=vigil
WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/vigil
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/vigil/env
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/vigil watch --config /etc/vigil/vigil.json --log-format json
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
TimeoutStopSec=20s

NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/vigil
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectClock=true
ProtectHostname=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true
LockPersonality=true
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
